title: Nex Platform Documentation
description: Complete documentation for the Nex Game Platform - a lightweight, performance-optimized HTML5 game delivery system with built-in and custom loading screens.

items.label: What is Nex?
items.content:
# Nex Game Platform

Nex is a lightweight HTML5 game platform that lets you embed and play web games with minimal setup. With version 1.1, you can choose between a built-in elegant loader or create your own custom loading experience.

## Quick Start

Add the Nex script to your HTML:

```html
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/UseNex/nex-js@afd45d45f9f5025481a999dde0379b5fbde5d9ce/nex.min.js"></script>
```

Then use the `<nex-game>` element:

```html
<!-- Built-in loader (white ring + blur) -->
<nex-game alias="2048" gid="my-game-1"></nex-game>

<!-- Or with custom loader mode -->
<nex-game alias="granny" gid="my-game-2" loading-screen="true"></nex-game>
```

That's it! The game will automatically load and be ready to play.

items.label: Installation
HTML Attributes
items.content:
# Component Attributes

The `<nex-game>` element supports these attributes:

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `alias` | string | Yes | Game identifier (e.g., `"fnaf"`, `"2048"`) |
| `gid` | string | Yes | Unique session ID for your game instance |
| `loading-screen` | string | No | `"true"` = custom loader mode, `"false"` = built-in loader (default) |

## Loading Screen Modes

### Built-in Loader (Default)
Shows a beautiful white ring with blur background and progress percentage.

```html
<nex-game alias="2048" gid="game-1"></nex-game>
<!-- or explicitly -->
<nex-game alias="2048" gid="game-1" loading-screen="false"></nex-game>
```

### Custom Loader Mode
No built-in loader is shown. You must provide your own loading UI using the progress events.

```html
<nex-game alias="granny" gid="game-2" loading-screen="true"></nex-game>
```

## Example

```html
<!-- With built-in loader -->
<nex-game alias="fnaf" gid="game-123"></nex-game>

<!-- With custom loader mode and styling -->
<nex-game 
  alias="2048" 
  gid="puzzle-game"
  loading-screen="true"
  style="width: 800px; height: 600px;"
></nex-game>
```

items.label: JavaScript API
items.content:
# JavaScript API (`window.nex`)

Control your game instance using the global API.

## Methods

### `on(eventName, callback)`
Listen to game lifecycle events.

```js
window.nex["my-game"].on("ready", () => {
  console.log("Game loaded!")
})
```

### `start()`
Start the game manually. Required for both built-in and custom loader modes.

```js
window.nex["my-game"].start()
```

## Events

| Event | When it fires |
|-------|---------------|
| `progress` | During loading (0-100%) - only fires in custom loader mode |
| `ready` | Game is fully loaded - fires in both modes |
| `error` | Something went wrong |

## Complete Example (Custom Loader)

```js
const gid = "my-game"

// Listen for progress events
window.nex[gid].on("progress", (data) => {
  console.log(`Loading: ${data.progress}%`)
  // Update your custom loader UI here
})

window.nex[gid].on("ready", () => {
  console.log("Ready to play!")
  // Hide your custom loader
  document.getElementById('loader').style.display = 'none'
  window.nex[gid].start()
})

window.nex[gid].on("error", (err) => {
  console.error("Error:", err.message)
})
```

items.label: Overview
items.content:
# Metadata API

The Metadata API lets you discover and access game information without loading the actual game.

## Available Methods

### `window.nex.metadata.getAllAliases()`
Get a list of all game identifiers.

```js
const games = window.nex.metadata.getAllAliases()
console.log(games) // ['2048', 'fnaf', 'slope', ...]
```

### `window.nex.metadata.get(alias)`
Get metadata for a specific game.

```js
const game = window.nex.metadata.get("2048")
console.log(game.name) // "2048"
console.log(game.category) // "Puzzle"
```

### `window.nex.metadata.getAllMetadata()`
Get metadata for all games at once.

```js
const allGames = window.nex.metadata.getAllMetadata()
// Returns object with all game metadata
```

### `window.nex.metadata.alias[alias]`
Shortcut to access game metadata.

```js
const game = window.nex.metadata.alias["fnaf"]
console.log(game.name) // "Five Nights at Freddy's"
```

## Thumbnail URL Pattern

All game thumbnails follow this pattern:

```
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/UseNex/thumbnails@afd45d45f9f5025481a999dde0379b5fbde5d9ce/{alias}.webp
```

**Specifications:**
- **Dimensions**: 400px width × 300px height
- **Aspect Ratio**: 4:3
- **Format**: WebP

items.label: Game Structure
items.content:
# Game Metadata Structure

Each game in the Nex platform has the following structure:

```ts
interface GameMetadata {
  alias: string        // Unique identifier
  name: string         // Display name
  category: string     // Game genre/category
  description: string  // Short description
  img: string          // Thumbnail URL (400x300px WebP)
}
```

## Example Game Data

```js
{
  "alias": "fnaf",
  "name": "Five Nights at Freddy's",
  "category": "Horror",
  "description": "Manage security room power and doors to survive creepy animatronic robots.",
  "img": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/UseNex/thumbnails@afd45d45f9f5025481a999dde0379b5fbde5d9ce/fnaf.webp"
}
```

## Categories

Games are organized into these categories:
- **Action** - Fast-paced gameplay
- **Puzzle** - Logic and problem-solving
- **Strategy** - Planning and tactics
- **Sports** - Athletic competitions
- **Racing** - Speed and driving
- **Driving** - Vehicle simulation
- **Skill** - Precision and timing
- **Horror** - Scary experiences
- **Simulation** - Life and management
- **Sandbox** - Creative freedom
- **Clicker** - Idle and incremental

items.content:
# Common Issues & Solutions

## Game doesn't load

**Solution:** Check that you're using a valid alias.

```js
const valid = window.nex.metadata.getAllAliases()
console.log('Available games:', valid)
```

## Duplicate GID error

**Solution:** Use unique GIDs for each instance.

```js
const gid = `game-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 6)}`
```

## Game won't start

**Solution:** Make sure to call `start()` after the `ready` event in both modes.

```js
window.nex[gid].on('ready', () => {
  window.nex[gid].start() // Required!
})
```

## Thumbnails not loading

**Solution:** Check if the game exists and the CDN is accessible. Thumbnails are 400x300px WebP images with the new commit hash.

```js
const game = window.nex.metadata.get('2048')
if (game) {
  console.log('Thumbnail URL:', game.img)
  // Will load a 400x300px 4:3 WebP image
  // URL: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/UseNex/thumbnails@afd45d45f9f5025481a999dde0379b5fbde5d9ce/2048.webp
}
```

## Built-in loader not showing

**Solution:** Make sure `loading-screen` is not set to `"true"`.

```html
<!-- Built-in loader shows -->
<nex-game alias="2048" gid="game-1"></nex-game>

<!-- No built-in loader -->
<nex-game alias="2048" gid="game-1" loading-screen="true"></nex-game>
```

## Custom loader not receiving progress events

**Solution:** Set `loading-screen="true"` and ensure you're listening for the `progress` event.

```js
window.nex[gid].on('progress', (data) => {
  console.log(data.progress) // Should log 0-100
})
```

## CORS issues

**Solution:** The Nex CDN endpoints are configured for cross-origin requests. If you're developing locally, serve your page through a local server instead of opening the file directly.

## Game loads but screen is blank

**Solution:** Make sure you called `start()` after the `ready` event.

```js
window.nex[gid].on('ready', () => {
  window.nex[gid].start() // This renders the game
})
```

items.label: Loader Modes
items.content:
# Loading Screen Modes

Nex 1.1 introduces two loading screen modes to give you full control over the user experience.

## Built-in Loader (Default)

When `loading-screen` is not set or set to `"false"`, Nex shows its elegant built-in loader.

**Features:**
- White circular progress ring
- Blurred game thumbnail background
- Percentage counter (0% - 100%)
- Game title display
- Smooth fade-out transition
- Error message display

```html
<nex-game alias="granny" gid="game-1"></nex-game>
```

## Custom Loader Mode

When `loading-screen="true"`, Nex does NOT show any built-in loader. You must provide your own loading UI.

**Features:**
- No built-in UI elements
- Full control over loading visuals
- Progress events (0-100%)
- Ready event to hide loader
- Error event for failure handling

```html
<nex-game alias="granny" gid="game-1" loading-screen="true"></nex-game>
```

## Event Flow Comparison

| Event | Built-in Mode | Custom Mode |
|-------|---------------|-------------|
| `progress` | Fires (optional) | Fires (required for UI) |
| `ready` | Fires, auto-starts | Fires, you must call `start()` |
| `error` | Shows in loader | You handle in UI |

## Visual Comparison

```
┌─────────────────────┐     ┌─────────────────────┐
│  🌫️ Blur background  │     │  ✨ Your own design  │
│  ⭕ White ring 100%   │     │  ⚡ Custom spinner   │
│  "Granny"            │     │  📊 Your progress    │
│  [Laden...]          │     │  🎨 Your branding    │
└─────────────────────┘     └─────────────────────┘
   Built-in Loader            Custom Loader
```
